title: Feraligatr R 015/071 SV5K Japanese Pokemon Card Wild Force Scarlet & Violet TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Pokemon Card from the Scarlet & Violet set features Feraligatr, a Water type Stage 2 Pokemon. The card is part of the Wild Force edition and has a rare rarity with a holo finish. It has a card number of sv5K-015/071 and is made of paper material. 

The card is standard size and is suitable for ages 9 and up. It is not autographed and is not a vintage item. The card is manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and is in Japanese language. This collectible card game item is perfect for any fan of the Pokemon TCG and is a great addition to any collection.
